summary: The four-digit microwave contract fixes both fields to values from 00 through 99, leaving no scalable workload axis for an honest runtime trend.

workload_bound.source_constraint: an entry has exactly two normalized minute digits, so its minute field ranges only from 00 through 99

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference inspects each of the 100 possible minute fields once and evaluates only fields whose derived seconds value lies from 00 through 99.

Regression covers every target from 1 through 6039 and every starting digit against independent enumeration of all canonical one-to-four-digit entries, using equal, movement-dominant, pressing-dominant, and asymmetric costs.
